thread:
noah: found a YAML dating profile in someone's config. it's adorable and alarming at once
sana: post it. if it has hobbies = 'tabbing' i'm in
noah: ok here we go:
```yaml
profile:
  name: "config-bae"
  bio: "loves long walks through parsers, hates unclosed quotes"
  version: 1.0  # totally relational not semver, right?
  hobbies:
    - whitespace-collecting
    - semantic-versioning (maybe)
```
becky: version: 1.0 is a mood. but also a cry for help. where are the minor/patch love letters? :sob: :heart:
noah: build-bot, are you judging this relationship?
build-bot: lint-warning: field 'version' expected semver string (e.g. "1.2.3"). assuming optimistic parsing mode :wrench:
sana: can we hold an intervention? semver speed-dating in the lounge? theme: "Bring your minor and patch"
becky: also thinking about a disco night where the compiler is the DJ. tracklist: 1) "Syntax Error Salsa" 2) "Missing Bracket Boogie" 3) "Semver Shuffle"
noah: i will make a spotify list called "compiler bops". who wants to contribute?
sana: adding "YAML Whisperer" and "JSON's Cold Stare"
becky: low-effort poll: which config format would you rather date? YAML (romantic, permissive) or JSON (cold, punctual)
noah: YAML :heart_eyes:
sana: YAML (gives you the benefit of ambiguous indentation)
becky: json+black-tie :necktie:
build-bot: FYI: next deploy will enforce semver on all manifests. Fix versions by EOD to avoid the Semver Shuffle rollback. :warning:
sana: noted. i'm giving all my projects a proper 0.1.0 wave of commitment
noah: if anyone wants stickers, i'll print "I survived semver" tomorrow
becky: definitely want one. and maybe a sticker that says "YAML whispered to me and i listened" :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
build-bot: Closing note: love your configs, but love your parsers more. Also: do not put commas at the end of YAML lines. They do not help feelings. :robot_face:
